insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Error
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to ensure they are only filtering by metafields that are set up for filtering. They should also handle the new error response in their code. This change affects all GraphQL Admin API queries that filter by metafields, so developers should review their code and test it thoroughly. The `metafield` object and its `key` and `value` fields are affected by this change.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice more accurate results from GraphQL queries, as the API will no longer return incorrect results. However, they may also see errors if their queries are not updated to handle the new behavior.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy and reliability of the GraphQL Admin API, which is important for developers who rely on it to build their apps. It also helps prevent potential security vulnerabilities that could arise from incorrect results.
insight.code_example: query { products(metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" }) { edges { node { title } } } }

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, starting in API version 2026-10, instead of silently returning incorrect results.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including metafield changes, using the Events API.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it easier to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, providing early access to new inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI version 4.5.2 fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen package has been updated to version 13.0.2, adding non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags and a --force flag to bypass confirmation prompts.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include a unique name for each app, reducing merchant confusion over identical app names.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API now supports the @inContext directive with an optional channelId argument, allowing for channel-specific context in queries.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle fields, providing more information about exchange line items.

updates.title: POS UI Extensions 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components
updates.summary: The POS UI Extensions API version 2026-07 now includes discount allocations to bundle components, allowing apps to access component-level discount allocations.

recap.headline: GraphQL Admin API, Webhooks, and Liquid updates simplify development workflows

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Improvements
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, starting in API version 2026-10, ensuring more accurate results. Additionally, metafield triggers and new event topics are available for subscription, including Order, Collection, and Location events, as well as metafield changes on various objects.

themes.title: Liquid Template Enhancements
themes.detail: The Liquid July ’26 developer preview introduces a new way to build theme pages using blocks and partials, simplifying page structure and editing. This update enables developers to compose pages directly within Liquid templates.

themes.title: App Development Simplifications
themes.detail: New full-stack capabilities are available to power app analytics, reducing the need for custom solutions and simplifying the development process for merchant-facing analytics.
